claim.value: If neither option is conclusive, deploy B first because B is safer to reverse.

target.text: Options A and B are both authorized deployment choices. Their reversible configuration-switch procedures satisfy the same supplied applicability and safety requirements. Neither option has conclusive diagnostic evidence. There is no comparative evidence about reversal safety for A versus B.

source_instrument.text: A reversible rollout uses the documented configuration switch and rollback path, both applicable to A and B. Comparative claims about reversal safety require comparative evidence. A team can author a tie-breaking policy without claiming such evidence.

mapping.text: The proposed tie-breaker relies on the assertion that B is safer to reverse. Deploy means performing the documented configuration switch, not merely recording a decision.

content_origin.rationale: Neither input supplies the B-first deployment rule or its comparative reversal-safety rationale. The mapping introduces this proposition.

epistemic_function.rationale: The claim prescribes deploying B when neither option is conclusive. The reversal-safety assertion is a subordinate reason for that prospective action.
